note: Colorbox Field Formatter provides three @FieldFormatter plugins assigned on Manage display (no admin page, configure=null; requires the Colorbox module): colorbox_field_formatter (string/computed), colorbox_field_formatter_image (image, adds image_style + special 'hide'), colorbox_field_formatter_entityreference (entity_reference, hides link_type/link). Settings live in the entity_view_display component: style (default|colorbox-inline|colorbox-node), link_type (content|manual), link (URI, token-aware), width, height, iframe, inline_selector, anchor, class, rel; image variant adds image_style. Each item renders as <a class="colorbox <style>"> with ?width=&height= query. Medium cases read back a live view-display component's colorbox settings (a distinctive width; a manual link target); hard cases switch a field to the colorbox formatter and tune its popup width + iframe, verified against the live entity_view_display.

evals.prompt: How do I make a field on my Drupal content type open in a Colorbox lightbox using the colorbox_field_formatter module? Where do I set it?
evals.expected_output: On the entity's Manage display, set the field's Format to one of the module's Colorbox FF formatters (colorbox_field_formatter for string/computed, colorbox_field_formatter_image for image, colorbox_field_formatter_entityreference for entity_reference). Settings are stored in the entity_view_display component. Requires the Colorbox module.

evals.prompt: With colorbox_field_formatter, can the Colorbox link point somewhere other than the entity's own page? What setting controls the link destination?
evals.expected_output: Yes. The 'Link colorbox to' setting (link_type) is either 'content' (the entity's canonical URL) or 'manual', where you type a URI in the 'link' setting that is token-replaced when the Token module is enabled.

evals.prompt: In colorbox_field_formatter, which formatter handles image fields and lets me pick an image style, and which setting groups several links into one Colorbox gallery?
evals.expected_output: colorbox_field_formatter_image handles image fields and adds an 'Image style' setting (any style, or 'hide' to suppress the image). The 'rel' setting assigns a Colorbox group id so matching links cycle as a gallery.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article field field_cff_known is displayed with the Colorbox field formatter. Inspect the live display configuration and state the Colorbox popup width it is configured to use.
On this Drupal site, the Article field field_cff_link uses the Colorbox formatter with a manually entered link. Inspect the live display configuration and give the URL/path the Colorbox links to.
evals.expected_output: It links to /cff-target-page: the component has link_type = manual and link = /cff-target-page in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a text field field_cff_task currently shown with the plain text formatter. Using colorbox_field_formatter, change its display so the field opens in a Colorbox lightbox. Apply the change to the live default view display.
evals.expected_output: core.entity_view_display.node.article.default content.field_cff_task.type = colorbox_field_formatter (set the field's Format to 'Colorbox FF' on Manage display or setComponent).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article field field_cff_dim already uses the Colorbox field formatter. Configure it so the Colorbox popup width is 900 and iframe mode is enabled. Apply the change to the live default view display.
evals.expected_output: The field_cff_dim component settings have width = 900 and iframe = 1 (truthy) in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default.
